I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random: "Thanks @Ilse Varga, noted: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 10 June. I haven't changed anything else."

She said no action was needed, so that reply is all I did. I didn't read #north-team or look up her earlier post, and I didn't repeat the old date. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, and she had already posted this one in the channel, so it was fine to repeat it there.
